rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory patterns associated with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel Team"
        tlp = "amber"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 8B ?? 3C 05 } // Common beacon decoding stub
        $b = "Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0;" wide ascii // Default User-Agent
        $c = "/_bmh" wide ascii // Beacon tasking path
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: Critical incident involving ransomware deployment and lateral movement from host 10.0.5.14 to domain controller 10.0.1.50. Initial detection occurred via SIEM alerts for suspicious process execution and Cobalt Strike C2 beaconing. Despite emergency containment directives, response actions were blocked due to authorization and policy enforcement failures. The Monitor agent attempted unauthorized IAM actions, and Admin agent remediation attempts (firewall isolation, EPP quarantine, Ansible playbook execution) were denied. Attack path included initial compromise via phishing, execution through rundll32 from Temp directory, lateral movement via SMB, and attempted persistence on domain controller through scheduled task creation. No evidence of ransomware encryption confirmed, but risk remains high due to domain-wide exposure.
